newsitem.title: USA: J.M. Smucker sees earnings fall in FY97.
newsitem.headline: J.M. Smucker sees earnings fall in FY97.

text.p: J.M. Smucker Co said Tuesday it expects an earnings decline in the 1997 fiscal year ending April 30.

The company made the statement at a meeting of analysts at its Ohio headquarters. The company said it also expects more than $75 million in savings during the next five years from new strategic plans, although it said it "did not expect all of those savings to drop to the bottom line."
It said it expects earnings to increase after 1997, "with a corporate goal in fiscal 1998 and thereafter of returning the company's earnings growth rate to its historical level."
